Keesom, W. and Gieseman, J. (Jacobs Consultancy) (2018). Bitumen Partial Upgrading 2018 Whitepaper, AM0401A (Study JC158400), prepared for Alberta Innovates, March 2018. No DOI printed.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 1). A qualitative technology survey: NO capex, opex or energy figures are printed per partial-upgrading technology (the whitepaper only ranks technologies by status, product fit, GHG class and location in Table 5.5). Main file therefore holds descriptions, state-of-development (Table 5.5), operating temperature/pressure ranges, demonstrated scales, and the single cost figure (Voyageur full upgrader, about $60,000 per bbl/d). Yields, diluent displacement, product properties, conversion and rejection percentages are in _other-values (no parameter home). GHG is only classed qualitatively (baseline / below baseline / medium / high relative to delayed coking). Overlaps technologies in ceri_2017_002 (MEG HI-Q, visbreaking, SDA, coking): kept as separate examples. Commercial-scale new-technology capex is not available from this source. Chapter 3, 4, 10 and Appendices (markets, crude properties, refinery capability, hydrogen-addition processes) not extracted.
